questions.q: How many languages are listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India at present?
questions.e: The Eighth Schedule lists 22 languages. Bodo, Dogri, Maithili and Santhali were the last four added, in 2003.

questions.q: The language that a child first acquires at home in early childhood is called the
questions.e: The first language learnt naturally at home is the mother tongue or L1. Languages learnt later are L2, L3 and so on.

questions.q: Chomsky's Language Acquisition Device (LAD) is believed to be
questions.e: Chomsky argued that humans are born with an innate faculty, the LAD, that lets children acquire language quickly.

questions.q: According to Krashen's input hypothesis, acquisition occurs when learners receive comprehensible input at the level ______.
questions.e: Here i is the learner's current level. Input slightly beyond it (i + 1) is understandable and pushes the learner forward.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Broca's area is located in the temporal lobe.
II. Wernicke's area is mainly concerned with language comprehension.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Broca's area lies in the frontal lobe and controls speech production. Wernicke's area, in the temporal lobe, handles comprehension.

questions.q: Which of the following languages was NOT added to the Eighth Schedule by the 92nd Constitutional Amendment (2003)?
questions.e: Bodo, Dogri, Maithili and Santhali were added in 2003. Nepali was added earlier, by the 71st Amendment in 1992, with Konkani and Manipuri.

questions.q: In a Class VI classroom, many children speak a home language different from the school language. In line with NCF 2005's view of multilingualism, the teacher should
o: forbid the home language in class to improve fluency in the school language
treat the children's home languages as a resource and allow their use in learning
teach content only after they master the school language
questions.e: NCF 2005 treats multilingualism as a resource and favours building on the home language of the child, not suppressing it.

questions.q: The idea of language across the curriculum holds that every teacher, whatever the subject, is also a ______ teacher.
questions.e: Subject learning happens through language, so every teacher helps develop learners' vocabulary and expression in the subject.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. In Verbal Behavior, Skinner explained language learning through reinforcement and imitation.
II. Chomsky's 1959 review strongly criticised this behaviourist account of language.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both are correct. Skinner gave a behaviourist account, and Chomsky's review challenged it sharply, turning attention towards innate language ability.

questions.q: The critical period hypothesis for first-language acquisition, linked to puberty, was put forward by
questions.e: Eric Lenneberg (1967) proposed that language is acquired most easily before puberty. Krashen is known for the input and affective filter hypotheses.
